question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage is about the great scholar of Bangla language and literature, Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah. He was born in West Bengal, India in 1885. After completing graduation and post graduation, he joined Dhaka University as a Professor. He received the Doctorate Degree from Sorbonne University. Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah is the author of the first well arranged history of Bengali literature, Bangla Shahitter Kotha. This great contributor of Bangla language and literature passed away in 1969 in Dhaka.
